description: Source code for branch management in a Git-like version control system, including functions for tracking, creating, validating, and removing branches and their configurations, as well as handling submodules and worktrees.

classes.name: tracking
classes.description: Structure representing tracking information for a branch, including refspec, sources, remote, and match count.

classes.name: find_tracked_branch_cb
classes.description: Callback structure used for finding tracked branches, containing tracking info and ambiguous remotes list.

methods.name: find_tracked_branch
methods.description: Function to find tracking information for a remote and update tracking state.

methods.name: should_setup_rebase
methods.description: Determines if rebase should be set up based on the origin and autorebase setting.

methods.name: install_branch_config_multiple_remotes
methods.description: Installs upstream tracking configuration for a branch with multiple remotes.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Installs upstream tracking configuration for a branch with a single remote.

methods.name: inherit_tracking
methods.description: Inherits tracking info from an existing branch.

methods.name: setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets up tracking configuration for a branch, handling ambiguity and inheritance.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description of a branch from config.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates a branch name and checks if it already exists.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates a new branch name, optionally forcing if it exists.

methods.name: check_tracking_branch
methods.description: Checks if a remote has a tracking branch matching the given ref.

methods.name: validate_remote_tracking_branch
methods.description: Validates that a remote tracking branch exists.

methods.name: dwim_branch_start
methods.description: Determines the real starting point for a branch based on user input, expanding and validating the ref.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch, optionally forcing, with tracking setup.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Creates a branch and sets up tracking based on user input.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a branch in a superproject and submodules recursively.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge-related state files and references.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes branch state including merge and squash info.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Checks if a branch is currently checked out in any worktree and aborts if so.
